# Authored units and literal numeric labels

`literal_formats.ods` is a deterministic, original source generated by
`tools/generate_xls_literals_fixture.py`; `literal_formats.xls` was converted
with LibreOffice 7.4.7.2. No external or personal documents are used.

Eight independent expected rows cover mass units, negative values, a literal
currency label, an escaped percent without scaling, a date-like word, Cyrillic,
and simultaneous prefix/suffix. Expectations are hand-authored in the source
and tests, never obtained from the parser. The XLS preserves numeric values.

The opt-in `OFFICE_CORPUS_LIBREOFFICE=1` test independently exports displayed
CSV from XLS and compares every cell to expectations. CLI JSON is checked too.
The ODS generation is reproducible; LibreOffice's binary XLS metadata may vary.
